explanation: An ancient unit of currency that also symbolizes the gifts, abilities, or resources God gives each person to use on His behalf.
In this context, it describes the wise and responsible attitude of those who are ready for God's coming by taking care of what they have been given.
Describes those who lack preparation, wisdom, or the ability to act rightly in time before the day of judgment arrives.
In the parable of the ten virgins, it represents the presence of the Holy Spirit and personal faith that cannot be shared with others when the time comes.
Symbolizes the final moment when the opportunity to enter God's kingdom is closed, often associated with the day of judgment or death.
The term for those who have lived in accordance with God's will and shown mercy to others, leading to eternal life.
Those who have ignored God's message and failed to act according to His demands for love and justice toward the needy.
In the parable of the sheep and goats, the faithful disciples or the righteous are represented as those who are welcomed into heaven.
They represent those who have shown themselves indifferent to God's will and the needs of others, leading to eternal punishment.
In Matthew 25, this often refers to the coming kingdom where God rules righteously after the final judgment.
